description: This file declares the interface for the factory class IServerManagerModuleServiceFactory, which provides methods to create instances of server management modules within the Rialto media server IPC component. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and references to external dependencies.

classes.name: IServerManagerModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: An abstract factory class that provides methods to instantiate server management module services within the Rialto IPC framework.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new instance of IServerManagerModuleServiceFactory.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to a ServerManagerModule object, given a reference to an ISessionServerManager.
